ontology_evidence.query_text:
SELECT ?subject ?predicate ?value WHERE {
  ?subject <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#courseCode> ?catalogCode .
  FILTER(UCASE(STR(?catalogCode)) = STR(?code))
  ?subject ?predicate ?value .
  FILTER(?predicate IN (
    <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type>,
    <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#isRequiredForMajor>,
    <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#isElectiveForMajor>,
    <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#isRequiredForSpecialization>,
    <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#isElectiveForSpecialization>,
    <http://www.semanticweb.org/henrydao/ontologies/2025/7/TrainingProgramOntology#offeredInSpecialization>
  ))
}
